text: Both engines gone, over New York City, and two hundred and eight seconds to decide. First, the captain starts a small engine in the tail. It keeps the flight computers alive. LaGuardia? Teterboro? He judges he can't reach either one, and falling short means crashing into the city. So he picks the one long, flat, open stretch below. The Hudson River. Two hundred and eight seconds after the birds hit, the Airbus touches the water. And everyone survives. Here's how he pulled it off. Full video on my channel.
